note: Hand-written for the site (explanations and examples are our own), graded like Taiwan's junior high English (owner, 2026-11-06). An example's or question's en is the English sentence itself (the English UI shows no hint). Edit this file, then run: python tools/build_grammar.py

title.en: The verb be: am, is, are

form.zh: I am・you／we／they are・he／she／it is　縮寫：I'm・you're・he's・it's
form.en: I am · you / we / they are · he / she / it is · short forms: I'm, you're, he's, it's

explain.zh: be 動詞是「是、在」，跟著主詞變化：I am a student.（我是學生。）She is in the library.（她在圖書館。）否定在後面加 not，疑問句把 be 動詞移到句首：Are you OK?
explain.en: be means “is / are” and changes with the subject: I am a student, She is in the library. Add not after it for the negative, and put it first for a question: Are you OK?

notes.zh: 複數主詞（包含 A and B）用 are：Tom and I are friends.
notes.en: Plural subjects, including A and B, take are: Tom and I are friends.

notes.zh: 否定縮寫：isn't、aren't，但 am not 沒有縮寫成 amn't。
notes.en: Negative short forms: isn't, aren't — but there's no amn't.

mistakes.zh: my brother 是單數，用 is。
形容詞前面不能少了 be 動詞。
mistakes.en: You can't leave out be before an adjective.

examples.text: I'm from Taiwan.
examples.en: I'm from Taiwan.

examples.text: Is your father a teacher?
examples.en: Is your father a teacher?

examples.text: We aren't late.
examples.en: We aren't late.

quiz.q: Amy and Ben（　）in the same class.
quiz.en: Amy and Ben are in the same class.
Is it cold today?
I am not hungry.

title.zh: 現在簡單式（第三人稱單數加 -s）

form.zh: I／you／we／they ＋ 原形・he／she／it ＋ 原形-s／-es　（go → goes、study → studies、have → has）
form.en: I / you / we / they + verb · he / she / it + verb-s / -es (go → goes, study → studies, have → has)

explain.zh: 說習慣、事實用現在簡單式：I walk to school every day.（我每天走路上學。）主詞是第三人稱單數（he、she、it、一個人或東西）時，動詞要加 -s 或 -es：She likes music.
explain.en: Use the present simple for habits and facts: I walk to school every day. With he, she, it or one person or thing, add -s or -es: She likes music.

notes.zh: -s、-sh、-ch、-x、-o 結尾加 -es：watches、goes；子音＋y 改 -ies：studies。
notes.en: After -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o add -es: watches, goes; consonant + y → -ies: studies.

notes.zh: 常和 every day、usually、on Sundays 一起用。
notes.en: It often goes with every day, usually, on Sundays.

mistakes.zh: he 是第三人稱單數，動詞要加 -s。
have 的第三人稱單數是 has。

examples.text: My sister gets up at six every morning.
examples.zh: 我姊姊每天早上六點起床。
examples.en: My sister gets up at six every morning.

examples.text: They live near the MRT station.
examples.en: They live near the MRT station.

examples.text: The sun rises in the east.
examples.en: The sun rises in the east.

quiz.en: Kevin studies English every day.
My parents watch TV in the evening.
The store opens at nine.

title.zh: 一般動詞的否定和疑問：do、does
title.en: Negatives and questions with do / does

form.zh: 否定：主詞 ＋ don't／doesn't ＋ 原形　疑問：Do／Does ＋ 主詞 ＋ 原形 …？
form.en: negative: subject + don't / doesn't + verb · question: Do / Does + subject + verb …?

explain.zh: 一般動詞（不是 be 動詞）要靠 do／does 來變否定和疑問。第三人稱單數用 does，而且後面的動詞要回到原形：She doesn't like coffee.、Does he play the piano?
explain.en: Ordinary verbs need do / does for negatives and questions. With he / she / it use does, and the verb goes back to its base form: She doesn't like coffee, Does he play the piano?

notes.zh: 簡答：Yes, I do. ／ No, she doesn't.
notes.en: Short answers: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.

mistakes.zh: doesn't 後面用原形，-s 已經在 does 上了。
mistakes.en: After doesn't use the base form — the -s is on does.

mistakes.zh: she 用 does。

examples.text: I don't eat breakfast on weekends.
examples.en: I don't eat breakfast on weekends.

examples.text: Does your brother have a bike?
examples.en: Does your brother have a bike?

examples.text: We don't have class on Saturday.
examples.en: We don't have class on Saturday.

quiz.en: Does your cat sleep a lot?
Mr. Lin doesn't eat meat.
They don't know the answer.

title.zh: 可數名詞、不可數名詞和複數

form.zh: 可數：a／an ＋ 單數、複數 -s／-es　不可數：water、milk、money（不加 -s、不加 a）
form.en: countable: a / an + singular, plural -s / -es · uncountable: water, milk, money (no -s, no a)

explain.zh: 能一個一個數的名詞是可數名詞，單數前面要有 a／an，複數加 -s：a pen、three pens。不可數名詞（液體、材料、抽象的東西）沒有複數，要用單位來數：a glass of milk、two pieces of paper。
explain.en: Countable nouns take a / an or -s: a pen, three pens. Uncountable nouns (liquids, materials, ideas) have no plural; count them with units: a glass of milk.

notes.zh: some 用在肯定句，any 用在否定句和疑問句：I have some cookies. ／ Do you have any questions?
notes.en: some in statements, any in negatives and questions: I have some cookies. / Do you have any questions?

notes.zh: 不規則複數：man → men、child → children、foot → feet、tooth → teeth。
notes.en: Irregular plurals: men, children, feet, teeth.

mistakes.zh: information 是不可數名詞，沒有 -s。
child 的複數是 children。

examples.text: Can I have a glass of water?
examples.en: Can I have a glass of water?

examples.text: She has two dogs and a cat.
examples.en: She has two dogs and a cat.

examples.text: We don't have any milk.
examples.en: We don't have any milk.

quiz.en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
Do you have any homework today?
Please buy two loaves of bread.

form.zh: a ＋ 子音開頭（a book）・an ＋ 母音發音開頭（an apple、an hour）・the ＋ 特定的人事物
form.en: a + consonant sound (a book) · an + vowel sound (an apple, an hour) · the + something specific

explain.zh: 第一次提到、不特定的單數可數名詞用 a／an；說話雙方都知道是哪一個時用 the：I have a cat. The cat is white.（我有一隻貓。那隻貓是白色的。）
explain.en: Use a / an for a singular countable noun mentioned for the first time; use the when both of you know which one: I have a cat. The cat is white.

notes.zh: a／an 看「發音」不看字母：an hour（h 不發音）、a university（發 /ju/ 的音）。
notes.en: a / an follows the sound, not the letter: an hour, a university.

notes.zh: 獨一無二的東西加 the：the sun、the moon；樂器也加 the：play the piano。
notes.en: Unique things take the: the sun, the moon; so do instruments: play the piano.

mistakes.zh: honest 的 h 不發音，母音開頭用 an。
mistakes.en: The h in honest is silent: an.

mistakes.zh: 球類運動前面不加 the。

examples.text: I eat an egg every morning.
examples.en: I eat an egg every morning.

examples.text: The book on the desk is mine.
examples.en: The book on the desk is mine.

examples.text: My sister plays the violin.
examples.en: My sister plays the violin.

quiz.en: He is an English teacher.
Look at the moon! It's so bright.
We waited for an hour.

title.zh: 代名詞：主格、受格、所有格

form.zh: 主格 I／you／he／she／it／we／they　受格 me／you／him／her／it／us／them　所有格 my／your／his／her／its／our／their　所有格代名詞 mine／yours／his／hers／ours／theirs
form.en: subject I … they · object me … them · possessive my … their · possessive pronoun mine … theirs

explain.zh: 當主詞用主格（She is kind.），放在動詞或介系詞後面用受格（I like her.、with them），名詞前面用所有格（her bag），單獨使用表示「…的東西」用所有格代名詞（The bag is hers.）。
explain.en: Use subject pronouns as the subject (She is kind), object pronouns after a verb or preposition (I like her, with them), possessives before a noun (her bag) and possessive pronouns on their own (The bag is hers).

notes.zh: its 是「它的」，it's 是 it is 的縮寫，不要搞混。
notes.en: its means “belonging to it”; it's is it is.

mistakes.wrong: Me and my friend go to school together.
mistakes.right: My friend and I go to school together.
mistakes.zh: 當主詞要用 I，而且習慣把自己放後面。
mistakes.en: As a subject use I, and put yourself last.

mistakes.zh: 單獨使用要用 mine。

examples.text: Can you help me?
examples.en: Can you help me?

examples.text: Their house is bigger than ours.
examples.en: Their house is bigger than ours.

examples.text: The dog is wagging its tail.
examples.en: The dog is wagging its tail.

quiz.q: This is Linda. I often play with（　）.
quiz.zh: 這是琳達，我常常跟她玩。
quiz.en: This is Linda. I often play with her.

quiz.q: Is this umbrella（　）? – No, mine is blue.
quiz.zh: 「這把傘是你的嗎？」「不是，我的是藍色的。」
quiz.en: Is this umbrella yours? – No, mine is blue.
They are my classmates.

form.zh: There is ＋ 單數／不可數名詞・There are ＋ 複數名詞　疑問：Is there …? ／ Are there …?
form.en: There is + singular / uncountable · There are + plural · questions: Is there …? / Are there …?

explain.zh: 說「某處有某物」用 there is／are，be 動詞跟著後面的名詞變：There is a park near my home.（我家附近有一座公園。）There are thirty students in my class.
explain.en: To say something exists somewhere, use there is / are, matching the noun after it: There is a park near my home, There are thirty students in my class.

notes.zh: 「有」不要用 have 來說存在：There is a cat under the table.，不說 It has a cat under the table。
notes.en: Don't use have for existence: There is a cat under the table.

mistakes.zh: people 是複數，用 are。

mistakes.wrong: There have a bank near here.
mistakes.right: There is a bank near here.
mistakes.zh: there 後面接 be 動詞，不接 have。
mistakes.en: there is followed by be, not have.

examples.text: There is a convenience store on the corner.
examples.en: There is a convenience store on the corner.

examples.text: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
examples.en: Are there any eggs in the fridge?

examples.text: There isn't much time.
examples.en: There isn't much time.

quiz.en: There are two cats on the sofa.
Is there a post office near here?
There is some juice in the bottle.

form.zh: 疑問詞 ＋ be 動詞 ＋ 主詞…？　疑問詞 ＋ do／does ＋ 主詞 ＋ 原形…？
form.en: question word + be + subject …? · question word + do / does + subject + verb …?

explain.zh: 疑問詞放句首，後面接一般的疑問句語序：Where is the bathroom?、What do you want for dinner? 常用的還有 How many（多少個）、How much（多少錢）、How old（幾歲）、How often（多常）。
explain.en: Put the question word first, then normal question order: Where is the bathroom?, What do you want for dinner? Also: How many, How much, How old, How often.

notes.zh: 問「誰」當主詞時不用 do：Who lives here?（誰住這裡？）
notes.en: When who is the subject, no do: Who lives here?

mistakes.zh: 一般動詞的疑問句要有 do／does。
mistakes.en: Questions with ordinary verbs need do / does.

mistakes.wrong: How many money do you have?
mistakes.right: How much money do you have?
mistakes.zh: money 不可數，用 how much。

examples.text: What time does the movie start?
examples.en: What time does the movie start?

examples.text: How often do you go swimming?
examples.en: How often do you go swimming?

examples.text: Why are you so happy today?
examples.zh: 你今天為什麼這麼開心？
examples.en: Why are you so happy today?

quiz.zh: 「你的生日是什麼時候？」「在五月。」
quiz.en: When is your birthday? – It's in May.
How many brothers do you have? – Two.
Where does Jenny work?

form.zh: am／is／are ＋ 動詞-ing（make → making、swim → swimming、lie → lying）
form.en: am / is / are + verb-ing (making, swimming, lying)

explain.zh: 說「現在正在做」的事：be 動詞 ＋ V-ing：I'm doing my homework.（我正在寫功課。）Look! It's raining.（你看！在下雨。）常和 now、right now、Look!、Listen! 一起出現。
explain.en: For what is happening now: be + verb-ing: I'm doing my homework, Look! It's raining. Often with now, right now, Look!, Listen!

notes.zh: 表示狀態、感覺的動詞通常不用進行式：I know him.（不說 I'm knowing him.）
notes.en: State verbs usually aren't continuous: I know him, not I'm knowing him.

mistakes.zh: 進行式不能少了 be 動詞。
短母音＋子音結尾要重複子音：swimming。
mistakes.en: Double the consonant after a short vowel: swimming.

examples.text: Shh! The baby is sleeping.
examples.en: Shh! The baby is sleeping.

examples.text: What are you doing right now?
examples.en: What are you doing right now?

examples.text: We're waiting for the bus.
examples.en: We're waiting for the bus.

quiz.en: Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.
The children are running in the park.
Is your mom working now?

form.zh: 主詞 ＋ can／can't ＋ 原形　疑問：Can ＋ 主詞 ＋ 原形…？
form.en: subject + can / can't + verb · question: Can + subject + verb …?

explain.zh: can 表示能力（會）、可能或許可（可以）：I can swim.（我會游泳。）Can I use your phone?（我可以用你的手機嗎？）can 後面一律接原形，所有主詞都一樣，不加 -s。
explain.en: can expresses ability or permission: I can swim, Can I use your phone? It's followed by the base form and never takes -s.

notes.zh: 過去式是 could：I could read when I was four.
notes.en: The past is could: I could read when I was four.

notes.zh: Could you …? 比 Can you …? 更客氣。
notes.en: Could you …? is politer than Can you …?

mistakes.zh: can 不加 -s。

mistakes.wrong: I can to ride a bike.
mistakes.zh: can 後面直接接原形，不加 to。

examples.text: My grandma can't use a smartphone.
examples.zh: 我奶奶不會用智慧型手機。
examples.en: My grandma can't use a smartphone.

examples.text: Can you play the guitar?
examples.en: Can you play the guitar?

examples.text: You can sit here.
examples.en: You can sit here.

quiz.en: Penguins can't fly.

quiz.zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦嗎？
quiz.en: Can I borrow your eraser?
My little brother can't read yet.

form.zh: 原形 ＋ …（Open the door.）・Don't ＋ 原形（Don't run.）・Be ＋ 形容詞（Be quiet.）・Let's ＋ 原形（Let's go.）
form.en: verb + … (Open the door.) · Don't + verb (Don't run.) · Be + adjective (Be quiet.) · Let's + verb (Let's go.)

explain.zh: 叫別人做事時用動詞原形開頭，不說主詞；不准做就加 Don't。邀請大家一起做用 Let's ＋ 原形。加上 please 比較客氣：Please sit down.
explain.en: To tell someone to do something, start with the base form and no subject; Don't for “don't”. Let's + verb invites others to join. please makes it polite: Please sit down.

notes.zh: 形容詞前面要加 Be：Be careful!、Don't be late!
notes.en: Adjectives need Be: Be careful!, Don't be late!

mistakes.zh: 形容詞前面要有 be。
Let's 後面直接接原形。
mistakes.en: Let's takes the base form directly.

examples.text: Please turn off your phone.
examples.en: Please turn off your phone.

examples.text: Don't touch that!
examples.en: Don't touch that!

examples.text: Let's take a break.
examples.en: Let's take a break.

quiz.en: Be careful! The floor is wet.
Don't eat in the library.
Let's see a movie tonight.

form.zh: always（總是）> usually（通常）> often（常常）> sometimes（有時）> seldom（很少）> never（從不）　位置：一般動詞前、be 動詞後
form.en: always > usually > often > sometimes > seldom > never · before ordinary verbs, after be

explain.zh: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞前面（I usually walk to school.），但放在 be 動詞和助動詞後面（She is always late.、I can never remember.）。
explain.en: They go before ordinary verbs (I usually walk to school) but after be and helping verbs (She is always late, I can never remember).

notes.zh: never 本身就是否定，不再加 not：I never drink coffee.
notes.en: never is already negative: I never drink coffee.

mistakes.wrong: He goes always to bed late.
mistakes.right: He always goes to bed late.
mistakes.zh: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞前面。
mistakes.en: Frequency adverbs go before ordinary verbs.

mistakes.zh: never 不能再和 not 一起用。

examples.text: I often read before bed.
examples.en: I often read before bed.

examples.text: My dad is never angry.
examples.en: My dad is never angry.

examples.text: We sometimes eat at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們有時候去夜市吃東西。
examples.en: We sometimes eat at the night market.

quiz.en: Tina is always late for school.

quiz.zh: 我通常星期天打掃房間。
quiz.en: I usually clean my room on Sundays.

quiz.zh: 他從不吃蔬菜，他討厭蔬菜。
quiz.en: He never eats vegetables. He hates them.

title.en: The past of be: was, were

form.zh: I／he／she／it ＋ was・you／we／they ＋ were　否定：wasn't、weren't
form.en: I / he / she / it + was · you / we / they + were · negatives: wasn't, weren't

explain.zh: 說過去「是、在」用 was／were：I was at home yesterday.（我昨天在家。）The test was easy.（考試很簡單。）疑問句把 was／were 移到句首：Were you busy last week?
explain.en: For the past of be use was / were: I was at home yesterday, The test was easy. In questions they go first: Were you busy last week?

notes.zh: 常和 yesterday、last week、two days ago、in 2020 一起用。
notes.en: Often with yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2020.

mistakes.wrong: We was in Tainan last summer.
mistakes.right: We were in Tainan last summer.
mistakes.zh: we 用 were。
be 動詞的疑問句不用 did。
mistakes.en: Questions with be don't use did.

examples.text: The weather was great yesterday.
examples.en: The weather was great yesterday.

examples.text: Where were you last night?
examples.en: Where were you last night?

examples.text: I wasn't hungry, so I didn't eat.
examples.en: I wasn't hungry, so I didn't eat.

quiz.en: My parents were in Japan last month.
Was the movie interesting?

quiz.q: I（　）at school yesterday. I was sick.
quiz.zh: 我昨天沒去學校，我生病了。
quiz.en: I wasn't at school yesterday. I was sick.

form.zh: 規則動詞 ＋ -ed（play → played、stop → stopped、study → studied）・不規則（go → went、eat → ate、see → saw）　否定：didn't ＋ 原形　疑問：Did ＋ 主詞 ＋ 原形…？
form.en: regular verb + -ed (played, stopped, studied) · irregular (went, ate, saw) · negative: didn't + verb · question: Did + subject + verb …?

explain.zh: 說過去發生、已經結束的事用過去式：I visited my grandparents last weekend.（我上週末去看爺爺奶奶。）過去式不分人稱。否定和疑問用 did，後面的動詞回到原形。
explain.en: For finished past events: I visited my grandparents last weekend. The past is the same for every subject. Negatives and questions use did with the base form.

notes.zh: 常見不規則動詞：have → had、make → made、buy → bought、take → took、come → came、write → wrote。
notes.en: Common irregulars: had, made, bought, took, came, wrote.

mistakes.wrong: I didn't went to the party.
mistakes.right: I didn't go to the party.
mistakes.zh: didn't 後面用原形。
mistakes.en: After didn't use the base form.

mistakes.zh: buy 的過去式是 bought。

examples.text: We watched a movie last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚看了一部電影。
examples.en: We watched a movie last night.

examples.text: Did you finish your homework?
examples.en: Did you finish your homework?

examples.text: He lost his wallet on the bus.
examples.zh: 他在公車上弄丟了錢包。
examples.en: He lost his wallet on the bus.

quiz.q: I（　）a cake for my mom yesterday.
quiz.zh: 我昨天為媽媽做了一個蛋糕。
quiz.en: I made a cake for my mom yesterday.
Did they win the game?
Sam went to Kenting two years ago.

form.zh: was／were ＋ 動詞-ing　常和 when、while 一起用
form.en: was / were + verb-ing · often with when, while

explain.zh: 說過去某個時間點「正在做」的事：At eight last night, I was taking a shower.（昨晚八點我正在洗澡。）一件長的事進行中、被另一件短的事打斷：I was sleeping when the phone rang.
explain.en: For something in progress at a past moment: At eight last night, I was taking a shower. A longer action interrupted by a short one: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

notes.zh: while 後面接進行中的長動作：While I was walking home, it started to rain.
notes.en: while introduces the longer action: While I was walking home, it started to rain.

mistakes.wrong: I was watch TV at nine.
mistakes.right: I was watching TV at nine.
mistakes.zh: was 後面要用 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: When I was eating, he was calling me.
mistakes.right: When I was eating, he called me.
mistakes.zh: 打斷的短動作用過去簡單式。
mistakes.en: The short, interrupting action is past simple.

examples.text: What were you doing at ten last night?
examples.en: What were you doing at ten last night?

examples.text: It was raining when we left.
examples.en: It was raining when we left.

examples.text: While Mom was cooking, I set the table.
examples.zh: 媽媽在做飯時，我擺好了餐具。
examples.en: While Mom was cooking, I set the table.

quiz.zh: 他們昨天下午四點正在打籃球。
quiz.en: They were playing basketball at 4 p.m. yesterday.

quiz.q: I was reading when the lights（　）out.
quiz.zh: 我正在看書時燈突然熄了。
quiz.en: I was reading when the lights went out.
Was she sleeping when you got home?

title.en: The future: will and be going to

form.zh: will ＋ 原形（won't ＋ 原形）・am／is／are going to ＋ 原形
form.en: will + verb (won't + verb) · am / is / are going to + verb

explain.zh: 說未來的事有兩種：will 常用於當下決定、預測或承諾（I'll help you.）；be going to 用於已經計畫好的事或看得出來的跡象（We're going to visit Hualien next week.、Look at the clouds. It's going to rain.）。
explain.en: will is for decisions made now, predictions and promises (I'll help you); be going to is for plans and things you can see coming (We're going to visit Hualien next week, It's going to rain).

notes.zh: will 後面一律原形，不分人稱：She will come.
notes.en: will is the same for all subjects, followed by the base form: She will come.

mistakes.wrong: I will to call you tomorrow.
mistakes.zh: will 後面直接接原形。
mistakes.en: will takes the base form directly.

mistakes.wrong: He going to buy a car.
mistakes.right: He is going to buy a car.
mistakes.zh: be going to 不能少了 be 動詞。

examples.text: Don't worry. I'll be there on time.
examples.en: Don't worry. I'll be there on time.

examples.text: What are you going to do this weekend?
examples.en: What are you going to do this weekend?

examples.text: It will be sunny tomorrow.
examples.en: It will be sunny tomorrow.

quiz.q: We are going to（　）a party on Friday.
quiz.en: We are going to have a party on Friday.

quiz.q: The phone is ringing. – I（　）get it.
quiz.en: The phone is ringing. – I will get it.
Will you be home for dinner?

form.zh: 短形容詞 ＋ -er（tall → taller、big → bigger、easy → easier）・長形容詞：more ＋ 形容詞（more beautiful）・不規則：good → better、bad → worse　＋ than
form.en: short adjective + -er (taller, bigger, easier) · long: more + adjective (more beautiful) · irregular: better, worse · + than

explain.zh: 比較兩個人或東西用比較級 ＋ than：Taipei 101 is taller than this building.、Math is more difficult than English for me.
explain.en: Compare two things with the comparative + than: Taipei 101 is taller than this building, Math is more difficult than English for me.

notes.zh: 加強語氣用 much：much bigger（大得多），不用 very。
notes.en: Strengthen with much: much bigger, not very bigger.

mistakes.wrong: My bag is more heavy than yours.
mistakes.right: My bag is heavier than yours.
mistakes.zh: heavy 是短形容詞，改成 heavier。
good 的比較級是 better。

examples.text: My brother is taller than my dad.
examples.en: My brother is taller than my dad.

examples.text: This phone is more expensive than that one.
examples.en: This phone is more expensive than that one.

examples.text: I feel much better today.
examples.en: I feel much better today.

quiz.en: A dog is bigger than a mouse.

quiz.q: This book is（　）interesting than that one.
quiz.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
Your English is better than mine.

form.zh: the ＋ 形容詞-est（the tallest）・the most ＋ 長形容詞（the most popular）・不規則：the best、the worst　常接 in ＋ 地方／團體、of ＋ 複數
form.en: the + adjective-est (the tallest) · the most + long adjective (the most popular) · irregular: the best, the worst · often in + place / group, of + plural

explain.zh: 三個以上比較、說「最…」用最高級，前面要有 the：He is the tallest boy in our class.（他是我們班最高的男生。）This is the most beautiful beach in Taiwan.
explain.en: Use the superlative, with the, for “the most” among three or more: He is the tallest boy in our class, This is the most beautiful beach in Taiwan.

notes.zh: 範圍是地方或團體用 in（in the world），是一群人或東西用 of（of the three）。
notes.en: Use in with a place or group (in the world), of with a set of people or things (of the three).

mistakes.zh: smart 是短形容詞加 -est，而且要有 the。
mistakes.en: smart takes -est, and you need the.

mistakes.wrong: It's the better day of my life.
mistakes.right: It's the best day of my life.
mistakes.zh: 最高級是 best。

examples.text: Yushan is the highest mountain in Taiwan.
examples.en: Yushan is the highest mountain in Taiwan.

examples.text: Who is the youngest of the three?
examples.en: Who is the youngest of the three?

examples.text: This is the most delicious beef noodle soup I've ever had.
examples.zh: 這是我吃過最好吃的牛肉麵。
examples.en: This is the most delicious beef noodle soup I've ever had.

quiz.q: Winter is the（　）season of the year.
quiz.zh: 冬天是一年中最冷的季節。
quiz.en: Winter is the coldest season of the year.

quiz.q: Lisa is the most popular girl（　）our school.
quiz.zh: 麗莎是我們學校最受歡迎的女生。
quiz.en: Lisa is the most popular girl in our school.

quiz.q: That was the（　）meal I've ever eaten.
quiz.zh: 那是我吃過最難吃的一餐。
quiz.en: That was the worst meal I've ever eaten.

form.zh: as ＋ 形容詞／副詞原級 ＋ as・not as … as（沒有…那麼…）
form.en: as + adjective / adverb + as · not as … as

explain.zh: 說兩者「一樣…」用 as ＋ 原級 ＋ as：Tom is as tall as his father.（湯姆跟他爸爸一樣高。）否定 not as … as 是「沒有…那麼」：This movie isn't as good as the book.
explain.en: To say two things are equal: as + adjective + as: Tom is as tall as his father. not as … as means “less than”: This movie isn't as good as the book.

notes.zh: 中間用原級，不用比較級：as fast as，不是 as faster as。
notes.en: Use the plain form: as fast as, not as faster as.

mistakes.wrong: She is as taller as me.
mistakes.right: She is as tall as me.
mistakes.zh: as … as 中間用原級。
mistakes.en: Use the plain form between as … as.

mistakes.wrong: He runs as fast than you.
mistakes.right: He runs as fast as you.
mistakes.zh: 後面是 as，不是 than。
mistakes.en: The second word is as, not than.

examples.text: My cat is as heavy as a small dog.
examples.zh: 我的貓跟一隻小狗一樣重。
examples.en: My cat is as heavy as a small dog.

examples.text: The test wasn't as hard as I thought.
examples.zh: 考試沒有我想的那麼難。
examples.en: The test wasn't as hard as I thought.

examples.text: Please come as soon as possible.
examples.en: Please come as soon as possible.

quiz.en: Kaohsiung isn't as big as Taipei.
I'm as old as your sister.
He can't sing as well as you.

form.zh: have／has ＋ 過去分詞（visited、eaten、been、done）　常和 already、yet、ever、never、for、since 一起用
form.en: have / has + past participle (visited, eaten, been, done) · often with already, yet, ever, never, for, since

explain.zh: 現在完成式連接過去和現在：說經驗（I have been to Japan.）、已經完成的事（I have already eaten.）、從過去持續到現在的事（She has lived here for ten years.）。
explain.en: The present perfect links past and present: experience (I have been to Japan), something already done (I have already eaten), something that started in the past and continues (She has lived here for ten years).

notes.zh: for ＋ 一段時間（for three years），since ＋ 起點（since 2020）。
notes.en: for + a period (for three years), since + a starting point (since 2020).

notes.zh: 有明確的過去時間（yesterday、last year）時用過去式，不用完成式。
notes.en: With a finished time (yesterday, last year) use the past simple, not the perfect.

mistakes.zh: 有 yesterday 這種明確的過去時間，用過去式。
mistakes.en: With yesterday use the past simple.

mistakes.zh: has 後面要用過去分詞。

examples.text: Have you ever tried stinky tofu?
examples.en: Have you ever tried stinky tofu?

examples.text: I haven't finished the report yet.
examples.en: I haven't finished the report yet.

examples.text: We have known each other for five years.
examples.en: We have known each other for five years.

quiz.en: My dad has been to Europe twice.

quiz.q: I have studied English（　）I was eight.
quiz.en: I have studied English since I was eight.
Have you done your homework yet?

form.zh: must ＋ 原形（必須）・have／has to ＋ 原形（必須、不得不）・should ＋ 原形（應該）　mustn't（不准）・don't have to（不必）
form.en: must + verb · have / has to + verb · should + verb · mustn't (not allowed) · don't have to (not necessary)

explain.zh: must 和 have to 都是「必須」：You must wear a helmet.、I have to get up early. should 是建議「應該」：You should drink more water. 注意否定意思不同：You mustn't park here.（這裡不准停車。）You don't have to come.（你不必來。）
explain.en: must and have to both mean “need to”: You must wear a helmet, I have to get up early. should gives advice: You should drink more water. The negatives differ: mustn't = not allowed, don't have to = not necessary.

notes.zh: must 沒有過去式，過去的「必須」用 had to：I had to wait an hour.
notes.en: must has no past; use had to: I had to wait an hour.

mistakes.zh: must 後面直接接原形。
mistakes.en: must takes the base form directly.

mistakes.zh: he 用 has to。

examples.text: You should see a doctor.
examples.en: You should see a doctor.

examples.text: Students must not use phones in class.
examples.en: Students must not use phones in class.

examples.text: We don't have to wear uniforms on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我們星期五不必穿制服。
examples.en: We don't have to wear uniforms on Fridays.

quiz.zh: 很晚了，我現在得回家了。
quiz.en: It's late. I have to go home now.

quiz.q: You look tired. You（　）go to bed early.
quiz.zh: 你看起來很累，應該早點睡。
quiz.en: You look tired. You should go to bed early.

quiz.q: Last night I（　）finish a big project.
quiz.zh: 我昨晚得完成一個大報告。
quiz.en: Last night I had to finish a big project.

form.zh: want／need／hope／decide／plan ＋ to V・目的：to V（為了…）・It is ＋ 形容詞 ＋ to V
form.en: want / need / hope / decide / plan + to verb · purpose: to verb (in order to) · It is + adjective + to verb

explain.zh: 有些動詞後面接 to ＋ 原形：I want to travel.（我想去旅行。）to V 也可以表示目的：I went to the store to buy milk.（我去商店買牛奶。）還有 It's easy to make friends here.
explain.en: Some verbs are followed by to + verb: I want to travel. to + verb also gives a purpose: I went to the store to buy milk. And: It's easy to make friends here.

notes.zh: would like to ＋ 原形是有禮貌的「想要」：I'd like to order now.
notes.en: would like to is a polite “want to”: I'd like to order now.

mistakes.right: I want to go to Japan.
mistakes.zh: want 後面要有 to。

mistakes.wrong: She went out for buy some bread.
mistakes.right: She went out to buy some bread.
mistakes.zh: 表示目的用 to ＋ 原形。

examples.text: I need to charge my phone.
examples.en: I need to charge my phone.

examples.text: He saved money to buy a new computer.
examples.en: He saved money to buy a new computer.

examples.text: It's important to get enough sleep.
examples.en: It's important to get enough sleep.

quiz.en: We decided to take the bus.
I got up early to see the sunrise.
It is hard to learn a new language.

form.zh: enjoy／finish／mind／keep／practice ＋ V-ing・介系詞 ＋ V-ing（good at drawing）・V-ing 當主詞（Swimming is fun.）
form.en: enjoy / finish / mind / keep / practice + verb-ing · preposition + verb-ing (good at drawing) · verb-ing as subject (Swimming is fun.)

explain.zh: 動詞加 -ing 可以當名詞用：Reading is my hobby.（閱讀是我的嗜好。）某些動詞和所有介系詞後面要接 V-ing：I enjoy cooking.、Thank you for helping me.
explain.en: A verb + -ing can work as a noun: Reading is my hobby. Some verbs and every preposition are followed by -ing: I enjoy cooking, Thank you for helping me.

notes.zh: like、love、start 後面接 to V 或 V-ing 都可以：I like swimming. ＝ I like to swim.
notes.en: like, love, start take either: I like swimming = I like to swim.

mistakes.wrong: I enjoy to listen to music.
mistakes.zh: enjoy 後面接 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: He is good at play tennis.
mistakes.right: He is good at playing tennis.
mistakes.zh: 介系詞 at 後面接 V-ing。

examples.text: Have you finished cleaning your room?
examples.en: Have you finished cleaning your room?

examples.text: Riding a scooter in the rain is dangerous.
examples.en: Riding a scooter in the rain is dangerous.

examples.text: She's interested in learning Korean.
examples.en: She's interested in learning Korean.

quiz.en: Would you mind closing the window?
He left without saying goodbye.

quiz.zh: 請繼續努力，你做得很好！
quiz.en: Please keep trying. You're doing great!

title.en: Conjunctions: and, but, or, so, because

form.zh: and（和、而且）・but（但是）・or（或是）・so（所以）・because（因為）
form.en: and · but · or · so · because

explain.zh: 連接詞把兩個句子連起來：It was raining, so we stayed home.（下雨了，所以我們待在家。）I stayed home because I was sick.（我待在家，因為我生病了。）
explain.en: Conjunctions join two sentences: It was raining, so we stayed home. I stayed home because I was sick.

notes.zh: 英文的 because 和 so 不能同時用在一句裡（中文可以說「因為…所以…」）。
notes.en: Don't use because and so in the same sentence — one is enough.

mistakes.wrong: Because I was tired, so I went to bed.
mistakes.right: Because I was tired, I went to bed.
mistakes.zh: because 和 so 只能選一個。
mistakes.en: Use either because or so, not both.

mistakes.wrong: Do you want tea and coffee?
mistakes.right: Do you want tea or coffee?
mistakes.zh: 二選一用 or。
mistakes.en: A choice between two uses or.

examples.text: I like dogs, but my sister likes cats.
examples.zh: 我喜歡狗，但我妹妹喜歡貓。
examples.en: I like dogs, but my sister likes cats.

examples.text: Hurry up, or you'll miss the train.
examples.zh: 快一點，不然你會趕不上火車。
examples.en: Hurry up, or you'll miss the train.

examples.text: She studied hard, so she passed the exam.
examples.zh: 她很用功，所以通過了考試。
examples.en: She studied hard, so she passed the exam.

quiz.q: The shirt is nice,（　）it's too expensive.
quiz.zh: 這件襯衫很好看，但是太貴了。
quiz.en: The shirt is nice, but it's too expensive.

quiz.zh: 我很餓，因為我沒吃午餐。
quiz.en: I'm hungry because I didn't eat lunch.

quiz.q: It was very hot,（　）we went swimming.
quiz.zh: 天氣很熱，所以我們去游泳了。
quiz.en: It was very hot, so we went swimming.

title.en: Clauses with when, before, after, if

form.zh: when／before／after／if ＋ 句子，＋ 主要句子　未來的事：子句用現在式（If it rains tomorrow, …）
form.en: when / before / after / if + clause, + main clause · for the future the clause uses the present (If it rains tomorrow, …)

explain.zh: when（當…時）、before（在…之前）、after（在…之後）、if（如果）帶出一個子句，可以放前面（加逗號）或後面。說未來的事時，子句裡用現在式代替未來式：If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
explain.en: when, before, after and if start a clause that can go first (with a comma) or second. For the future, the clause uses the present, not will: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.

notes.zh: 主要子句照樣用 will：I'll call you when I arrive.
notes.en: The main clause still uses will: I'll call you when I arrive.

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay home.
mistakes.right: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
mistakes.zh: if 子句用現在式表示未來。
mistakes.en: The if clause uses the present for the future.

mistakes.wrong: I'll call you when I will get home.
mistakes.right: I'll call you when I get home.
mistakes.zh: when 子句也用現在式。
mistakes.en: The when clause uses the present too.

examples.text: Wash your hands before you eat.
examples.en: Wash your hands before you eat.

examples.text: When I was a child, I lived in Hsinchu.
examples.en: When I was a child, I lived in Hsinchu.

examples.text: If you're free tomorrow, let's go hiking.
examples.zh: 如果你明天有空，我們去爬山吧。
examples.en: If you're free tomorrow, let's go hiking.

quiz.q: If you（　）hard, you will pass the test.
quiz.zh: 如果你用功，就會通過考試。
quiz.en: If you study hard, you will pass the test.

quiz.q: Brush your teeth（　）you go to bed.
quiz.en: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.

quiz.q: I will text you when the movie（　）.
quiz.zh: 電影結束時我會傳訊息給你。
quiz.en: I will text you when the movie ends.

form.zh: be 動詞 ＋ 過去分詞（＋ by …）　現在：is／are made　過去：was／were made
form.en: be + past participle (+ by …) · present: is / are made · past: was / were made

explain.zh: 強調「被做的東西」而不是做的人時用被動語態：English is spoken in many countries.（很多國家說英文。）This temple was built in 1700.（這座廟建於 1700 年。）要說出是誰做的就加 by：The book was written by J. K. Rowling.
explain.en: Use the passive when the thing done matters more than who did it: English is spoken in many countries, This temple was built in 1700. Add by to name the doer: The book was written by J. K. Rowling.

notes.zh: be 動詞決定時態，過去分詞不變：is made／was made。
notes.en: be shows the tense; the participle stays: is made / was made.

mistakes.wrong: The window broken by the wind.
mistakes.right: The window was broken by the wind.
mistakes.zh: 被動語態不能少了 be 動詞。

mistakes.wrong: This car was make in Japan.
mistakes.right: This car was made in Japan.
mistakes.zh: be 動詞後面要用過去分詞。
mistakes.en: After be use the past participle.

examples.text: Bubble tea is loved all over the world.
examples.zh: 珍珠奶茶受到全世界喜愛。
examples.en: Bubble tea is loved all over the world.

examples.text: My bike was stolen last night.
examples.zh: 我的腳踏車昨晚被偷了。
examples.en: My bike was stolen last night.

examples.text: The classroom is cleaned every day.
examples.en: The classroom is cleaned every day.

quiz.q: This song was（　）by a famous singer.
quiz.zh: 這首歌是一位有名的歌手寫的。
quiz.en: This song was written by a famous singer.

quiz.zh: 亞洲很多地方都種稻米。
quiz.en: Rice is grown in many parts of Asia.
The letters were sent yesterday.

form.zh: 肯定句 ＋ 否定附加問句（It's hot, isn't it?）・否定句 ＋ 肯定附加問句（You don't eat pork, do you?）
form.en: positive sentence + negative tag (It's hot, isn't it?) · negative sentence + positive tag (You don't eat pork, do you?)

explain.zh: 在句子後面加一個短問句來確認：前面肯定、後面就否定，反之亦然。附加問句用前面的助動詞或 be 動詞，一般動詞就用 do／does／did，主詞換成代名詞：Your sister lives in Taichung, doesn't she?
explain.en: A short question at the end checks something: a positive sentence takes a negative tag and vice versa. Use the same helping verb or be — or do / does / did — with a pronoun: Your sister lives in Taichung, doesn't she?

notes.zh: I am 的附加問句是 aren't I：I'm right, aren't I?
notes.en: I am takes aren't I: I'm right, aren't I?

notes.zh: Let's … 的附加問句是 shall we：Let's go, shall we?
notes.en: Let's … takes shall we: Let's go, shall we?

mistakes.wrong: You are a student, are you?
mistakes.right: You are a student, aren't you?
mistakes.zh: 前面肯定，附加問句要否定。
mistakes.en: A positive sentence takes a negative tag.

mistakes.zh: 一般動詞用 does 來問。

examples.text: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
examples.en: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?

examples.text: You didn't forget the tickets, did you?
examples.en: You didn't forget the tickets, did you?

examples.text: They can come, can't they?
examples.en: They can come, can't they?

quiz.zh: 陳老師是你的老師，對吧？
quiz.en: Mr. Chen is your teacher, isn't he?
You won't tell anyone, will you?
Your parents went to Japan, didn't they?

form.zh: What ＋ a／an ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞（＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞）！・How ＋ 形容詞／副詞（＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞）！
form.en: What + a / an + adjective + noun (+ subject + verb)! · How + adjective / adverb (+ subject + verb)!

explain.zh: 表達驚訝、讚嘆時用感嘆句。重點是名詞用 What：What a cute dog!（好可愛的狗！）重點是形容詞或副詞用 How：How cute!、How fast he runs!（他跑得好快！）
explain.en: Exclamations show surprise or admiration. Use What when there's a noun: What a cute dog! Use How with just an adjective or adverb: How cute!, How fast he runs!

notes.zh: 複數或不可數名詞不加 a：What beautiful flowers!、What nice weather!
notes.en: No a with plural or uncountable nouns: What beautiful flowers!, What nice weather!

mistakes.zh: 有名詞時用 What。
weather 不可數，不加 a。

examples.text: What a great idea!
examples.en: What a great idea!

examples.text: How beautiful the night view is!
examples.en: How beautiful the night view is!

examples.text: What delicious dumplings!
examples.en: What delicious dumplings!

quiz.en: What an interesting story!
How tall you are!
What cute puppies!

form.zh: at ＋ 時刻（at 7:00、at night、at noon）・on ＋ 日期、星期（on Monday、on May 5）・in ＋ 月份、季節、年、一天的時段（in July、in 2025、in the morning）
form.en: at + clock time (at 7:00, at night) · on + day, date (on Monday, on May 5) · in + month, season, year, part of day (in July, in 2025, in the morning)

explain.zh: 範圍越小越精確用 at，一天用 on，比一天長的用 in：I have a meeting at three on Friday.、My birthday is in December.
explain.en: at for exact times, on for days, in for anything longer: I have a meeting at three on Friday, My birthday is in December.

notes.zh: 特定某一天的早上用 on：on Sunday morning。
notes.en: A particular day's morning takes on: on Sunday morning.

notes.zh: 前面有 this、next、last、every 時不加介系詞：next week、every day。
notes.en: No preposition with this, next, last, every: next week, every day.

mistakes.zh: 星期幾用 on。

mistakes.wrong: I'll see you on next week.
mistakes.zh: next 前面不加介系詞。

examples.text: The class starts at 8:10.
examples.en: The class starts at 8:10.

examples.text: We celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival in September or October.
examples.zh: 我們在九月或十月過中秋節。
examples.en: We celebrate Mid-Autumn Festival in September or October.

examples.text: What do you usually do on weekends?
examples.en: What do you usually do on weekends?

quiz.en: I was born in 2011.

quiz.zh: 那家店半夜十二點關門。

form.zh: 人 ＋ who／that ＋ …・東西 ＋ which／that ＋ …
form.en: person + who / that + … · thing + which / that + …

explain.zh: 關係代名詞把兩個句子合成一句，用來說明前面的名詞是哪一個：I have a friend who lives in Canada.（我有一個住在加拿大的朋友。）This is the cake that my mom made.（這是我媽媽做的蛋糕。）
explain.en: A relative pronoun joins two sentences to say which person or thing you mean: I have a friend who lives in Canada, This is the cake that my mom made.

notes.zh: 關係代名詞當受詞時可以省略：This is the cake (that) my mom made.
notes.en: When it's the object it can be left out: This is the cake (that) my mom made.

mistakes.wrong: The man which helped me was kind.
mistakes.right: The man who helped me was kind.
mistakes.zh: 說人用 who 或 that，不用 which。
mistakes.en: For people use who or that, not which.

mistakes.wrong: I like the dress who you bought.
mistakes.right: I like the dress (that) you bought.
mistakes.zh: 說東西用 which 或 that。
mistakes.en: For things use which or that.

examples.text: The girl who sits next to me is from Japan.
examples.zh: 坐我旁邊的女生是日本人。
examples.en: The girl who sits next to me is from Japan.

examples.text: This is the bus that goes to the zoo.
examples.zh: 這是開往動物園的公車。
examples.en: This is the bus that goes to the zoo.

examples.text: I lost the book which you lent me.
examples.zh: 我把你借我的書弄丟了。
examples.en: I lost the book which you lent me.

quiz.q: Do you know the boy（　）is singing?
quiz.zh: 你認識那個在唱歌的男生嗎？
quiz.en: Do you know the boy who is singing?

quiz.q: This is the phone（　）I bought last week.
quiz.en: This is the phone that I bought last week.

quiz.q: A dentist is a person（　）takes care of teeth.
quiz.en: A dentist is a person who takes care of teeth.

form.zh: Do you know／I don't know／Can you tell me ＋ 疑問詞 ＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞（直述句語序）・沒有疑問詞時用 if／whether
form.en: Do you know / I don't know / Can you tell me + question word + subject + verb (statement order) · no question word: if / whether

explain.zh: 問句放在另一個句子裡時，要改成直述句的語序，不再倒裝：Where is the station? → Do you know where the station is? 一般動詞的 do／does 也要拿掉：What does he want? → I don't know what he wants.
explain.en: A question inside another sentence goes back to statement order: Where is the station? → Do you know where the station is? Drop do / does too: What does he want? → I don't know what he wants.

notes.zh: 是非問句改成間接問句用 if：Is she coming? → I'm not sure if she is coming.
notes.en: Yes / no questions use if: Is she coming? → I'm not sure if she is coming.

mistakes.wrong: Do you know where is the bathroom?
mistakes.right: Do you know where the bathroom is?
mistakes.zh: 間接問句用直述句語序。

mistakes.wrong: I don't know what does she like.
mistakes.right: I don't know what she likes.
mistakes.zh: 拿掉 does，動詞加 -s。
mistakes.en: Drop does and add -s to the verb.

examples.text: Can you tell me how much this costs?
examples.zh: 可以告訴我這個多少錢嗎？
examples.en: Can you tell me how much this costs?

examples.text: I wonder why he is so quiet today.
examples.zh: 我在想他今天為什麼這麼安靜。
examples.en: I wonder why he is so quiet today.

examples.text: Do you know if the library is open?
examples.zh: 你知道圖書館有沒有開嗎？
examples.en: Do you know if the library is open?
